import unittest
import copy
from view import View

class TestView(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_begin_returns_incrementing_id(self):
        view = View()
        id1 = view.begin("query1")
        id2 = view.begin("query2")
        self.assertGreater(id2, id1)
        self.assertEqual(id1, 1)
        self.assertEqual(id2, 2)
    
    def test_begin_clears_error(self):
        view = View()
        view.error = "old error"
        id1 = view.begin("query1")
        self.assertIsNone(view.error)
    
    def test_begin_sets_loading_true(self):
        view = View()
        id1 = view.begin("query1")
        self.assertTrue(view.loading)
    
    def test_finish_with_same_id_accepts(self):
        view = View()
        view.begin("query1")
        result = view.finish(1, ["row1", "row2"])
        self.assertTrue(result)
        self.assertEqual(view.rows, ["row1", "row2"])
        self.assertFalse(view.loading)
    
    def test_finish_with_different_id_rejects(self):
        view = View()
        view.begin("query1")
        result = view.finish(2, ["row1"])
        self.assertFalse(result)
        self.assertEqual(view.rows, [])
    
    def test_finish_with_repeated_id_rejects(self):
        view = View()
        view.begin("query1")
        view.finish(1, ["row1"])
        result = view.finish(1, ["row2"])
        self.assertFalse(result)
        self.assertEqual(view.rows, ["row1"])
    
    def test_finish_preserves_old_rows_before_accept(self):
        view = View()
        view.begin("query1")
        view.finish(1, ["row1"])
        view.begin("query2")
        view.finish(2, ["row2"])
        self.assertEqual(view.rows, ["row2"])
    
    def test_get_accepted_rows(self):
        view = View()
        view.begin("query1")
        view.finish(1, ["row1", "row2"])
        accepted = view.get_accepted_rows()
        self.assertEqual(accepted, ["row1", "row2"])
        self.assertIsNot(accepted, view.rows)
    
    def test_notes_preserved(self):
        view = View()
        view.notes["job1"] = "note1"
        view.begin("query1")
        view.finish(1, ["row1"])
        self.assertIn("job1", view.notes)
        self.assertEqual(view.notes["job1"], "note1")
    
    def test_begin_keeps_notes(self):
        view = View()
        view.notes["job1"] = "note1"
        id1 = view.begin("query1")
        self.assertIn("job1", view.notes)
        self.assertEqual(view.notes["job1"], "note1")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
